content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD derivatives.F: a library of ten finite-difference derivative subroutines, all by Fengyan Shi (2010-2011). Lines 1-11 blank (preprocessor output), lines 12-55 BSD license header. Every subroutine has the same signature pattern (M,N,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,MASK,DX and/or DY,Uin,Uout), uses USE PARAM + IMPLICIT NONE, loops DO J=Jbeg,Jend / DO I=Ibeg,Iend, and multiplies the stencil by MASK(I,J). The ten: DERIVATIVE_Y_High (L63-79, d/dy stencil (Uin(I,J+2)+2Uin(I,J+1)-Uin(I,J-2)-2Uin(I,J-1))/DY/8); DERIVATIVE_X_High (L90-106, mirror in x); DERIVATIVE_Y (L116-132, centered (Uin(I,J+1)-Uin(I,J-1))/DY/2); DERIVATIVE_X (L142-158, mirror in x); DERIVATIVE_YY (L167-183, 3-point second derivative (Uin(I,J+1)-2Uin(I,J)+Uin(I,J-1))/DY/DY); DERIVATIVE_XY (L192-209, cross derivative via tmp1/tmp2 centered y-derivatives at I+1 and I-1 then centered x-difference, L203-205); DERIVATIVE_XX (L219-236, 3-point second derivative in x, comment 'I assume no 2nd derivative' L228); DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH (L246-270, 4th-order cross derivative: four 4th-order y-derivative rows tmp1..tmp4 at I-2,I-1,I+1,I+2 (L257-264, stencil (u-8u+8u-u)/12DY) combined as (tmp1-8tmp2+8tmp3-tmp4)/12DX at L265-266); DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH (L280-297, 4th-order-accurate 5-point second derivative (-Uin(I-2,J)+16Uin(I-1,J)-30Uin(I,J)+16Uin(I+1,J)-Uin(I+2,J))/(12DX^2) at L292-293); DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH (L307-323, mirror in y at L318-319). No file I/O and no calls to other subroutines.
entities: SUBROUTINE DERIVATIVE_Y_High(M,N,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,MASK,DY,Uin,Uout) @L63 (END @L79); decls: INTEGER,INTENT(IN)::M,N,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend @L66, Uin @L67, DY @L68, MASK @L69, Uout @L70

equations.ref: DERIVATIVE_Y centered difference, continuation -Uin(I,J-1))/DY/2.0_SP*MASK(I,J) on L128
DERIVATIVE_X centered difference, continuation on L154
DERIVATIVE_YY second derivative, continuation +Uin(I,J-1))/DY/DY*MASK(I,J) on L179
DERIVATIVE_XX second derivative, continuation +Uin(I-1,J))/DX/DX*MASK(I,J) on L232
DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH 4th-order y-derivative at I-2, continuation +8.0_SP*Uin(I-2,J+1)-Uin(I-2,J+2)) on L258; analogous tmp2 @L259, tmp3 @L261, tmp4 @L263
DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH 5-point 4th-order second derivative, continuation -30.0_SP*Uin(I,J)+16.0_SP*Uin(I+1,J)-Uin(I+2,J)) on L293
DERIVATIVE_YY_HIGH mirror in y, continuation on L319

verbatim_spans.text: !    DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH is subroutine to calculation 4th-derivative xy

unresolved: Loop indices I,J and temporaries tmp1,tmp2 (L203-204) and tmp1..tmp4 (L257-264) are not declared in any subroutine here; they must come from the PARAM module (cross-file)
Header comments call DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH/XX_HIGH/YY_HIGH '4th-derivative' (L240,L274,L301) but the code computes 4th-order-accurate first cross- and second derivatives — comment/code mismatch

DERIVATIVE_Y_High/X_High are titled 'first-derivative with higher-order' (L57,L83) but their stencil (u(+2)+2u(+1)-2u(-1)-u(-2))/(8h) differs from the standard 4th-order formula (-u(+2)+8u(+1)-8u(-1)+u(-2))/(12h) used inside DERIVATIVE_XY_HIGH (L257-264); the actual order/derivation is not stated in the file
DERIVATIVE_XX and DERIVATIVE_XX_HIGH both carry the comment 'I assume no 2nd derivative' (L228,L289) whose meaning in context is not explained
